visibleText.text: 仅供参考 · 请以官方最终信息为准

children: each card = framed_container + colored_left_accent + document_medallion + title + source_chip + status_chip + relative_time + right_chevron

alignments: page title and empty-state content are centered on the canvas horizontal axis
summary heading and count share one left rail while the subscription/filter action anchors to the right rail
category labels form one horizontal row with the selected first tab enclosed by a dedicated plate
all six news cards share fixed icon, title, chip, timestamp and chevron columns
news-card right chevrons align vertically near a common x position
empty-state emblem, heading, support text and retry action form a centered vertical stack
the bottom disclaimer icon and text form one centered horizontal group
spacingRhythm: header and summary are contiguous bands inside the shared shell
category filter frame sits directly below the summary and leaves roughly 24 px before the first result card
six result cards use approximately 146-148 px heights with approximately 10-12 px gaps
list to empty-state panel gap is approximately 16 px
empty-state panel to disclaimer gap is approximately 10 px
major framed regions use dark inset surfaces, clipped corners and layered metallic borders

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: full-canvas dark texture with tall metal perimeter frame
assetSlots.contentSemantics: non-factual black stone or oxidized-metal surface with layered corner hardware
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: retain a dark high-contrast shell and visible perimeter hierarchy if detailed material is unavailable

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: near-square clipped metal button with large left chevron
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: preserve a clearly recognizable left-chevron back control

assetSlots.contentSemantics: non-factual visual framing around the page title
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: a symmetric thin-line ornament may replace micro-detail

assetSlots.contentSemantics: cycle, refresh or subscription-related action symbol
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: retain a compact deterministic action glyph beside the button label

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: document symbol inside a clipped near-square metal holder
assetSlots.contentSemantics: generic news document, not a factual article image
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: repeat one consistent document icon holder for every row

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: micro-icons inside compact rounded rectangular chips
assetSlots.contentSemantics: source-reference marker, pending warning and translated check
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: preserve source, warning and success distinctions with legible deterministic icons

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: narrow vertical segmented rail following the left clipped corners
assetSlots.contentSemantics: three blue and three gold visual accents; target alone does not establish their data meaning
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: retain a narrow two-color accent treatment without asserting semantic truth

assetSlots.shapeOrAspect: large circular medallion, approximately 1:1, with radial ornaments
assetSlots.fallbackExpectation: retain a prominent centered unavailable-state icon
retain one small caution or shield marker before the disclaimer

interactionsSuggestedByTarget: large left header control suggests back navigation
the outlined '订阅/筛选' action suggests opening subscription or filter controls
each of the six category labels suggests a mutually exclusive category selection
the far-right sliders glyph suggests opening advanced filters
each framed news card and its right chevron suggest opening a news detail route
the empty-state button labeled '重试' suggests retrying the current query or load
unresolved: exact font families, authored weights, letter spacing, line heights and shadow parameters cannot be recovered from the static raster
micro-details inside the source-reference chip icon are not pixel-certain and may read as a shield, pin or gem-like marker
the summary action glyph resembles a cycle or refresh symbol, but its exact semantic label cannot be proven from the icon alone
small circular marks near the top-right header area and footer sides appear decorative, but their exact material role is unresolved
thin inner highlights, frame shadows and clipped-corner protrusions may extend 1-3 px beyond measured region bounds
the static target does not reveal category hit-box widths, pressed states, focus states or scroll behavior
six populated rows and the empty-state panel are both visibly present; no runtime-state relationship is inferred
all titles, counts, statuses and relative times are target-visible placeholders and are not treated as current runtime truth
